title: What is middleware in ASP.NET Core?
description: Learn how the middleware pipeline processes HTTP requests.

data.text: **Question:** What is middleware in ASP.NET Core?
Middleware are components that form the HTTP request pipeline. Each middleware can handle a request, pass it to the next component, or short-circuit the pipeline.

**Middleware Pipeline:**
- A chain of request delegates
- Each middleware decides whether to call next()
- Order matters - components execute in registration order
- On the way back, execution unwinds in reverse (onion model)
- Terminal middleware ends the pipeline

**Built-in Middleware:**
- UseRouting: adds route matching
- UseAuthentication: authenticates the user
- UseAuthorization: enforces authorization policies
- UseCors: enables CORS
- UseEndpoints: executes the matched endpoint
